# Process remaining songs (indices 3 to 10) - search and add
remaining_lines = song_lines[3:]
for line in remaining_lines:
    parts = line.split(" by ")
    title = parts[0].strip()
    artist_str = parts[1].strip() if len(parts) > 1 else ""
    # Split artists by comma
    artists_expected = [a.strip() for a in artist_str.split(",") if a.strip()]
    print(f"\nSearching: {title} by {artists_expected}")
    search_result = apis.spotify.search_songs(
        access_token=spotify_login['access_token'],
        query=title,
        page_limit=10
    )
    # Find exact match
    found = None
    for song in search_result:
        if song['title'].strip().lower() == title.lower():
            song_artists = [a['name'].strip().lower() for a in song['artists']]
            expected_lower = [a.lower() for a in artists_expected]
